spans.s:
The affix शतृ comes after the verb सु 'to press out or extract juice' when the sense is that of association with sacrifice.

Terms: शतृ

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), ष् is substituted for the स् of the particle सु when preceded by a word having in it the change-effecting letter इ etc.

Terms: षत्व change
